now.title: Echo#4
now.text: Lowak is one of Chula Battiest's ancestors, a Choctaw woman from centuries earlier. Her echo is among the visions that give Chula strength while she gives birth to Taloa.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An ancestor. Her echo gives Chula strength during Taloa's birth.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A descendant, given strength by Lowak's echo while giving birth to Taloa.

changes.evidence: Lowak is a Choctaw tribeswoman who lives in 1200 AD (Echo, 'Lowak' flashback). Chula, born in the 20th century, only sees her as one of the ancestral echoes in a vision while giving birth to Taloa (recounted in 'Taloa'). A blood tie never met, and the only link is a vision, which is not an event between people; nothing shows the two dealing with each other.

owner_calls.question: The tie stays (he is a Spider-Society member, which may include the chase after Miles), but is the text true? Sources list the Spectacular Spider-Man Peter only as a voiced Spider-Society cameo (and in a hologram); nothing found shows him urging Miles to accept canon events, which is Miguel's role. Keep the text, or reword it to the cameo?
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia lists Josh Keaton's Peter Parker / Spectacular Spider-Man among the Spider Society cameos; its hidden universe list marks 'Spectacular (hologram)'. The fandom page for Peter Parker (Earth-26496) has no ATSV plot detail beyond categories.
